page.notes: Blue ink rules, underlines and some blue marks run through the table (e.g. under several rows, and a blue line near "De Sphæra Cœlesti communi" and "De Vacuo"); these are later annotations, not printed, and were not transcribed. Several page numbers (e.g. "18" for De Igne, "11" for De Natura, "88" for De reliquis Phænomenis) are written in blue-tinted or hand-like figures; I read them as printed. The "pag. 1" in the first row is printed in italic. The numbers 25, 26 and 27 and the figure for De Igne are the least certain: they are marked here as read, not as [?]. The scan is cut off at the right edge; no text is lost there. The "E 2" at the foot is the gathering signature.
